validationCommands: cd ui && npm install && npm run build

tasks.title: Layered summary model
tasks.description: Extend WeeklySummary to Summary model with granularity (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY), date_from, date_to, key_themes (JSON), action_items (JSON). Add SummaryGranularity PyEnum. Migration 007_summary_model.py.

tasks.title: Summarization service
tasks.description: services/summarizer.py: summarize_notes(notes, granularity, entity_name) -> dict calling LLM. Include token budget, chunking for large note sets.

tasks.title: Scheduled background summarization
tasks.description: Background job that runs summarization on schedule. API endpoint to trigger. Integrates with existing cron/job infrastructure.

tasks.title: Review view overhaul
tasks.description: ui/src/views/Review.jsx: Progressive summary display, date picker, granularity selector, action items list.

tasks.title: AI link proposal generation
tasks.description: services/link_proposer.py: analyze notes, propose links based on semantic similarity, shared entities, temporal patterns. Returns list of {from_note_id, to_note_id, reason, confidence}.

tasks.title: Link proposals API
tasks.description: api/proposals.py: GET /api/v1/proposals (list pending), POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/accept (create link), POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/dismiss. Trigger generation: POST /api/v1/proposals/generate.

tasks.title: Proposals in NoteDetailView
tasks.description: NoteDetailView: show proposed links panel with accept/dismiss. Show confirmed links with backlinks.

tasks.title: Proposals in Review view
tasks.description: Review.jsx: show pending link proposals with context, bulk accept/dismiss, accept-all option.

mergePolicy: Merge validated task commits into overhaul/full-implementation-loop only; merge to main after all phases pass end-to-end validation.
queuePolicy: When no pending tasks remain, convert the next PLAN.md slice into bounded tasks with acceptance criteria before launching implementation agents.
